response.original_title: [Practical Guide]Need an Extra Room? How to Add a Stateroom to Your NCL Reservation
response.overview: To add a stateroom to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) reservation ,+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada) , you need to book a separate cabin and have NCL or your travel advisor link the two bookings.  Steps to Add a Room  • Make a new reservation: Book the additional room independently at current pricing and availability ,+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada) . Each room requires at least one adult. • Call for adjacent or connecting rooms: To ensure rooms are located near each other or connect, call NCL at 1-800-CRUISES (,+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada) ) or contact your travel agent rather than booking online ,+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada) , as agents can access broader inventory. • Link the bookings: Ask your agent or NCL representative to cross-reference or link your reservation numbers to coordinate dining and onboard preferences. • Consider group booking: For 6 or more staterooms, contact NCL's group department at ,+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada)
